pattern: SVG chart as a named, described group (role="group" with aria-roledescription) of role="img" data marks with roving focus; data table fallback (native table). Follows the WAI Complex Images tutorial (short name plus long description) and the roving tabindex technique of WAI-ARIA APG.

roles.role: group with aria-roledescription (localized chart type), named by the title
img with an aria-label: point name or series, x and y with their axis names (and size for bubbles)
list (ul) named "Legend"; entries are toggle buttons (aria-pressed)
group named "Zoom" of native buttons "Zoom in", "Zoom out", "Reset zoom"

roles.element: axes, decorative dense-point paths, tooltip, crosshair, selection brush
roles.role: aria-hidden (decorative duplicates of the accessible data)
table (native) with caption, column headers, and row headers; wide tables scroll in a focusable region

aria.value: id of the visible (or visually hidden) title
description id (when provided) and the generated summary id

Localized "{name}: {xAxis} {x}, {yAxis} {y}" (bubbles add ", {sizeAxis} {size}"); name is "{label}, {series}" for labelled points, else the series label. Example: "Group A: Height (cm) 160, Weight (kg) 55"
0 on exactly one mark (roving); other marks have none
true while the series is visible
Table open state and the table region id
true while the action is unavailable (Zoom in at the minimum span, Zoom out and Reset zoom when not zoomed); the button stays focusable

keyboard.action: Previous / next point of the same series in x order (then y); mirrored in RTL.

keyboard.context: Point focused, more than one visible series
keyboard.action: Point at the nearest x-order position in the previous / next visible series. With one series: previous / next point.
First / last point of the series (x order).
Hides the tooltip without moving focus (WCAG 1.4.13); it returns on the next move.
Zoom buttons (zoom enabled), legend buttons, then one tab stop for the plot (the active point), then the Show data table button and table region.
Shows or hides the series (native button).
Zoom in around the focused mark.
Zoom out around the focused mark.
Zoom in, zoom out, or reset (native button; ignored while aria-disabled).

focus: Roving focus: one point is in the tab sequence and remembers the last visited point across re-renders (resize, update, zoom) while it stays in view. Points outside the zoom window are not focusable. Toggling a legend entry keeps focus on its button; toggling the table keeps focus on the table button; zoom buttons stay focusable while aria-disabled.
notes: The generated summary names the chart type, series and point counts, and per series its point count and x and y ranges, plus hidden series.
Meaning never depends on color alone: each series has its own marker shape, repeated in the legend key.
Forced colors: marks use CanvasText (bubbles and outlines Canvas/CanvasText) and keep shapes and textures; focus uses Highlight.
No animation: nothing moves on render; hover and focus emphasis transitions are removed under prefers-reduced-motion and animation: none.
Above 600 visible points, points are virtual: two proxy marks alternate focus so every move is announced. Browse-mode users read the exact values from the data table.

Zoom changes are announced politely ("Showing {from} to {to}." or "Showing all data.") and emitted as aui-zoom. Pointer gestures (Ctrl/Cmd + wheel, drag pan, Shift + drag selection) have keyboard and toolbar equivalents.
The crosshair (crosshair option) is aria-hidden and follows both hover and keyboard focus; it hides when focus and the pointer leave.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack) is pending.
aria-roledescription support varies; screen readers without it announce "group".
